title: Ownership Map — Services/Modules (Platform + Shared Infra Touchpoints)
content:
SHEET: Overview
Owner map used by: SRE/IC, Support escalation, Eng managers.
Purpose: reduce paging ambiguity during incidents + map services to (team, on-call, escalation channels, SME backup).

Rules of thumb (please follow during incident):
- If you’re unsure between two owners, page PRIMARY owner listed here and @mention SECONDARY rotation in the incident channel.
- If the incident is cross-surface (e.g., routing + capacity), IC keeps single primary owner but assigns secondary owner explicitly in the incident channel topic.
- If a service is marked "Platform owns config/policy, Infra owns fleet" then route based on failure mode (see Notes/Boundaries).

Status: This sheet is the working source for the incident taxonomy rollout (ENG-4823). Confluence will be the published source once validated.
Last reviewed in review meeting: 2025-02-17 (Platform/SRE/Infra/Support)
Next review target: 2025-03-17


SHEET: Service Ownership Table
Columns:
Service/Module | Product surface | Deployments | Primary owning team | On-call rotation | Secondary escalation | Slack channels | SME (primary) | SME (backup) | Runbook | Dashboards | Notes/Boundaries | Typical taxonomy category

1) redwood-gateway (edge API gateway)
Service/Module: redwood-gateway
Product surface: Hosted API (REST + streaming)
Deployments: Hosted
Primary owning team: Platform (Edge/Gateway)
On-call rotation: platform-edge-oncall
Secondary escalation: sre-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-platform-oncall, #incidents, #support-escalations
SME (primary): Ethan Park
SME (backup): Logan Wright
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/gateway-5xx-and-timeouts
Dashboards: Grafana: gateway latency + 5xx; SLO: hosted-api-availability
Notes/Boundaries: Owns request authn plumbing, request routing to control-plane entrypoints, streaming transport. If errors correlate with fleet saturation, add Infra as secondary.
Typical taxonomy category: Edge/Gateway (HTTP 5xx, timeouts, streaming disconnects)

2) streaming-relay (SSE/WebSocket streaming relay)
Service/Module: streaming-relay
Product surface: Hosted API streaming responses
Deployments: Hosted
Primary owning team: Platform (Edge/Gateway)
On-call rotation: platform-edge-oncall
Secondary escalation: runtime-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-platform-oncall, #eng-runtime, #incidents
SME (primary): Mina Haddad
SME (backup): Hiro Tanaka
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/streaming-disconnects
Dashboards: Grafana: stream disconnect rate, p95 chunk interval
Notes/Boundaries: If disconnects map to backend token stalls, pull in Runtime. If disconnects map to client-facing load balancers, pull in Networking.
Typical taxonomy category: Edge/Gateway streaming

3) api-authz (API key + org policy + quotas)
Service/Module: api-authz
Product surface: Hosted API + Console
Deployments: Hosted, Dedicated (control plane)
Primary owning team: Platform (Control plane)
On-call rotation: platform-controlplane-oncall
Secondary escalation: sre-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-platform-oncall, #eng-sre, #support-escalations
SME (primary): Priya Natarajan
SME (backup): Mina Haddad
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/authz-quota-regressions
Dashboards: Grafana: authz error rate; Console: quota enforcement events
Notes/Boundaries: Security incidents (credential compromise) follow Security IR; this owner handles availability/behavioral regressions.
Typical taxonomy category: Control plane / AuthZ + quotas

4) smart-routing (policy engine + routing decisions)
Service/Module: smart-routing
Product surface: Hosted API + Dedicated routing
Deployments: Hosted, Dedicated
Primary owning team: Platform (Routing)
On-call rotation: routing-oncall
Secondary escalation: sre-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-platform-oncall, #incidents, #eng-sre
SME (primary): Mina Haddad
SME (backup): Ethan Park
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/routing-degraded-mode
Dashboards: Grafana: routing decision latency, fallback rate, 429/503 causes
Notes/Boundaries: Owns policy logic + compatibility/fallback. Fleet capacity issues should page Infra as secondary; runtime crashes should page Runtime.
Typical taxonomy category: Routing/Policy failures (fallback storms, bad routing decisions)

5) router-worker (request-to-backend router + retries)
Service/Module: router-worker
Product surface: Hosted API request handling
Deployments: Hosted
Primary owning team: Platform (Routing)
On-call rotation: routing-oncall
Secondary escalation: infra-fleet-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-platform-oncall, #eng-infra, #incidents
SME (primary): Mina Haddad
SME (backup): Keiko Yamamoto
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/router-overload
Dashboards: Grafana: router queue depth, retry rate, per-region saturation
Notes/Boundaries: If router queue is high due to GPU pool saturation, Infra owns mitigation (capacity), routing owns policy knobs (shed/fallback).
Typical taxonomy category: Routing overload / throttling

6) model-catalog (model registry + compatibility metadata)
Service/Module: model-catalog
Product surface: Hosted API model selection, Dedicated model pinning
Deployments: Hosted, Dedicated, Private (metadata sync where applicable)
Primary owning team: Platform (Model lifecycle)
On-call rotation: platform-model-oncall
Secondary escalation: runtime-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-platform-oncall, #eng-runtime, #incidents
SME (primary): Logan Wright
SME (backup): Sofia Ivanova
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/model-catalog-bad-metadata
Dashboards: Grafana: model version adoption, incompatibility errors
Notes/Boundaries: Bad model metadata causing widespread 4xx/5xx is Platform; model-specific runtime crashes is Runtime.
Typical taxonomy category: Model lifecycle / config regression

7) deployment-controller (rollouts, canaries, config sync)
Service/Module: deployment-controller
Product surface: Console rollouts + hosted config
Deployments: Hosted, Dedicated, Private (where Redwood-operated)
Primary owning team: Platform (Control plane)
On-call rotation: platform-controlplane-oncall
Secondary escalation: sre-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-platform-oncall, #eng-releases, #incidents
SME (primary): Ethan Park
SME (backup): Priya Natarajan
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/canary-rollback
Dashboards: Grafana: rollout status, config propagation lag
Notes/Boundaries: Owns rollout orchestration and config propagation. If bad config originated from Console UI, involve Product/Console team.
Typical taxonomy category: Control plane / rollout regression

8) tenant-config-store (org config + policy storage)
Service/Module: tenant-config-store
Product surface: Hosted + Dedicated control plane
Deployments: Hosted, Dedicated
Primary owning team: Platform (Control plane)
On-call rotation: platform-controlplane-oncall
Secondary escalation: observability-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-platform-oncall, #eng-observability, #incidents
SME (primary): Logan Wright
SME (backup): Sergio Costa
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/config-store-latency
Dashboards: Grafana: p99 store latency, error rate
Notes/Boundaries: If latency is due to underlying datastore/cluster health, engage Observability/Datastores.
Typical taxonomy category: Control plane dependency outage

9) usage-metering (token accounting + billing exports)
Service/Module: usage-metering
Product surface: Hosted API analytics + billing
Deployments: Hosted
Primary owning team: Platform (Telemetry datasets)
On-call rotation: telemetry-oncall
Secondary escalation: sre-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-platform-oncall, #eng-observability, #support-escalations
SME (primary): Logan Wright
SME (backup): Allison Grant
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/metering-delays
Dashboards: Grafana: ingestion lag, export job failures
Notes/Boundaries: Customer-impact is usually “reporting delayed” not serving outage. If it blocks quota enforcement, escalate to platform-controlplane-oncall.
Typical taxonomy category: Telemetry / reporting pipeline degradation

10) incident-annotations-emitter (control plane incident signals)
Service/Module: incident-annotations-emitter
Product surface: Internal ops (incident taxonomy attribution)
Deployments: Hosted, Dedicated
Primary owning team: Platform (Control plane)
On-call rotation: platform-controlplane-oncall
Secondary escalation: sre-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-platform-oncall, #eng-sre
SME (primary): Ethan Park
SME (backup): Miles Thornton
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/annotations-missing
Dashboards: Grafana: annotation volume, join success rate
Notes/Boundaries: This is not a customer-facing outage, but breaks dashboards/attribution. Prioritize during incident reviews.
Typical taxonomy category: Tooling/Observability gap

11) region-failover-controller (multi-region failover + health)
Service/Module: region-failover-controller
Product surface: Hosted API reliability / graceful degradation
Deployments: Hosted
Primary owning team: SRE (Reliability systems)
On-call rotation: sre-oncall
Secondary escalation: routing-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-sre, #eng-platform-oncall, #incidents
SME (primary): Sean Gallagher
SME (backup): Rafael Mendes
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/region-failover
Dashboards: Grafana: regional health, traffic shift events
Notes/Boundaries: SRE owns automation + policy; Routing owns compatibility/fallback correctness.
Typical taxonomy category: Regional outage / failover automation

12) redwood-console-internal (ops views, filters, incident views)
Service/Module: redwood-console-internal
Product surface: Console (internal ops)
Deployments: Hosted
Primary owning team: Product/Console (Internal tools)
On-call rotation: console-oncall
Secondary escalation: platform-controlplane-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-console, #eng-platform-oncall
SME (primary): Marissa Cole
SME (backup): Lauren Bishop
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/console-internal-broken
Dashboards: N/A (primarily app logs + Sentry)
Notes/Boundaries: Console bugs are not usually Sev1 unless blocking mitigation/rollouts.
Typical taxonomy category: Tooling / Console regression

13) dedicated-controlplane-agent (customer dedicated config agent)
Service/Module: dedicated-controlplane-agent
Product surface: Dedicated deployments
Deployments: Dedicated
Primary owning team: Platform (Dedicated control plane)
On-call rotation: platform-dedicated-oncall
Secondary escalation: infra-fleet-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-platform-oncall, #eng-infra, #support-escalations
SME (primary): Lauren Bishop
SME (backup): Ethan Park
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/dedicated-agent-heartbeat
Dashboards: Grafana: agent heartbeat, config drift
Notes/Boundaries: If dedicated pool health is degraded due to GPUs not provisioning, Infra owns capacity; Platform owns config/policy + agent connectivity.
Typical taxonomy category: Dedicated control plane connectivity

14) private-day2-operator (Redwood-operated private day-2 ops tooling)
Service/Module: private-day2-operator
Product surface: Private deployments (where Redwood is primary operator)
Deployments: Private (VPC/on-prem variants)
Primary owning team: Platform (Private deployments)
On-call rotation: platform-private-oncall
Secondary escalation: sre-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-platform-oncall, #eng-sre, #support-escalations
SME (primary): Vivek Kulkarni
SME (backup): Priya Natarajan
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/private-day2-ops
Dashboards: Grafana: private operator job health, connectivity checks
Notes/Boundaries: If customer-managed networking blocks access, Support/CS coordinates; Platform provides guidance but may not be able to mitigate directly.
Typical taxonomy category: Private deployment / operator tooling

15) net-egress-proxy (egress control + external deps)
Service/Module: net-egress-proxy
Product surface: Hosted + Dedicated
Deployments: Hosted, Dedicated
Primary owning team: Infra (Networking)
On-call rotation: networking-oncall
Secondary escalation: sre-oncall
Slack channels: #eng-infra, #eng-sre, #incidents
SME (primary): Victor Alvarez
SME (backup): Vanessa Ortiz
Runbook: Confluence /oncall/runbooks/egress-proxy
Dashboards: Grafana: egress errors, DNS failures
Notes/Boundaries: If issue manifests as upstream dependency timeouts, infra owns; platform can mitigate via feature flags to reduce dependency usage.
Typical taxonomy category: Networking / external dependency degradation


SHEET: Rotation + Paging Aliases (reference)
Rotation name | Paging alias | Coverage | Primary Slack channel | Notes
platform-edge-oncall | @platform-edge | 24/7 | #eng-platform-oncall | Gateway/streaming
platform-controlplane-oncall | @platform-controlplane | 24/7 | #eng-platform-oncall | AuthZ/config/rollouts
routing-oncall | @routing-oncall | 24/7 | #eng-platform-oncall | Policy + routing workers
telemetry-oncall | @telemetry-oncall | biz+weekend backup | #eng-observability | Metering + datasets
platform-dedicated-oncall | @platform-dedicated | 24/7 | #eng-platform-oncall | Dedicated control plane
platform-private-oncall | @platform-private | follow-the-sun (limited) | #eng-platform-oncall | Private day-2
sre-oncall | @sre-oncall | 24/7 | #eng-sre | IC + reliability
infra-fleet-oncall | @infra-fleet | 24/7 | #eng-infra | GPUs/provisioning/autoscaling
networking-oncall | @networking-oncall | 24/7 | #eng-infra | Network/DNS/egress
runtime-oncall | @runtime-oncall | 24/7 | #eng-runtime | Runtime crashes/scheduler
console-oncall | @console-oncall | biz hours + best effort | #eng-console | Internal console issues


SHEET: Notes / Known Gaps
- Some services do not yet have formal runbooks linked above (TODO list below).
- If you need to page Support/CS for comms: use #support-escalations and tag Dev Patel (Support escalation owner) or Jasmine Liu (comms sponsor).
- If the incident relates to security (credential leakage, unauthorized access, suspected exfil): do NOT follow this sheet; follow Security IR and engage #eng-security.

TODOs (tracked informally; will convert to Linear if not closed by rollout):
- Add runbook link for incident-annotations-emitter (Logan/Ethan)
- Confirm dedicated-controlplane-agent escalation boundary with Infra (Lauren/Irene)
- Normalize Slack channel naming (some teams use #eng-platform-oncall vs #eng-platform) (Rafael)

Change log
2025-02-18: Added private-day2-operator row; clarified streaming-relay boundary w/ Runtime; added secondary escalation for router-worker.
2025-02-05: Added region-failover-controller row; updated telemetry ownership to include metering exports.
2025-01-22: Initial population from stakeholder reviews + SRE incident inventory.
